concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 2 – User Story 1 – lines around T010‑T012
concerns.text: Unit and integration tests (T010, T011, T012) are listed before the implementation task that produces the code they test (T013 – DGP generation & harmonization). This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation; the tests will fail because the functions they validate do not exist yet.

Revision tasks are ordered as T039 (exclusion logging) before T040 (DGP module separation). T039 depends on the split modules introduced by T040, so the producer (T040) must precede the consumer (T039). The current order violates the required dependency sequencing.
